name: Mayonnaise (Commercial)
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated on SIBO diet as it's primarily fat and contains no fermentable carbohydrates.
preparationTips: Check ingredients for garlic or onion powder which would make it high FODMAP
Store in refrigerator and use within expiration date for food safety
Use as a base for low FODMAP sauces and dressings
Choose brands with simple ingredients: oil, eggs, vinegar, salt
nutritionalHighlights: High in vitamin E from vegetable oils
Provides healthy fats for nutrient absorption
Good source of omega-6 fatty acids
